Capability.name: Skills Gap Analysis
Capability.purpose: Compares required and current skill levels by role and finds skills held by only one person.

Capability.name: Workforce Plan
Capability.purpose: Compares future demand with projected supply for each role and sets the hire or develop route.

Capability.name: Succession & Bench Strength
Capability.purpose: Measures succession coverage for each critical seat.

Capability.name: Competency & 360 Review
Capability.purpose: Compares self and others’ ratings against expected levels to find gaps and blind spots.

Capability.name: Next-Role Readiness
Capability.purpose: Measures how ready a person is for a target role and how long the gaps take to close.

Capability.name: Development ROI
Capability.purpose: Shows how deeply each programme is evaluated and its return after attribution.

Consistency.name: Delivery Flow Metrics
Consistency.purpose: Measures how fast and how predictably work flows: throughput, cycle time, work in progress and flow efficiency.

Consistency.name: Drift & Stability Monitor
Consistency.purpose: Tells real drift from routine variation in any metric, so you react to signals and not to noise.

Consistency.name: Dependency Board
Consistency.purpose: Tracks what teams need from each other and when, and shows which dependencies are late and who is most often late.

Consistency.name: Workload & Capacity Balance
Consistency.purpose: Compares demand with capacity for each team or person and suggests where spare capacity could absorb overload.

Consistency.name: Operating Rhythm & Meeting Design
Consistency.purpose: Shows what your recurring meetings cost, how much is status updates, and whether weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews exist.

Consistency.name: Early Warning Indicators
Consistency.purpose: Tracks leading indicators against amber and red thresholds and shows how soon they will breach.

Consistency.name: Risk Register
Consistency.purpose: Keeps risks with owners and controls, and shows the heat map, risks above appetite and overdue actions.

Consistency.name: Business Continuity (BIA)
Consistency.purpose: Sets recovery priorities and finds activities that would not recover in time.

Consistency.name: Governance Assessment
Consistency.purpose: Assesses governance against recognised principles, with evidence for each answer.

Consistency.name: Commitments & Obligations Register
Consistency.purpose: Tracks contracts, partnership terms, public pledges and mandates against their due dates.

Consistency.name: Compliance Assessment
Consistency.purpose: Shows which compliance obligations are controlled and evidenced, by regulation.
